notes.title: Klobgniak 0.3.3.3 (Halloween Update)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The first update for "Klobgniak" has arrived!
These are the following changes:


HUD now shows that you have picked up the "hammer" or "scissors".



 Added icon "?" as one of the hints next to the items that the player should pay attention to.



 Added option for mouse sensitivity in "Pause Menu".



 "Collect" and "Interact" function is now on the same key (E key).



 Mr. Resident is slowed by 15%.



 Added small details in "Klobgniak's Home".


AND


 Pumpkin.


That's all in this update. Interact with this post and leave your feedback! Also, what do you think about the current state of this game? Your information would help me a lot. 

Thanks in advance!


Cheers!
